text:
mira (PM): Quick sync — need to lock priorities for the dedicated roadmap this quarter. Tension: predictable SLA vs low-cost elastic burst. Draft proposal: regional "soft guarantees" by default + paid "hard burst" add-on for enterprise pilots. Feedback?

kevin (sales): +1. Customers we talked to want guaranteed p99 latency during scheduled launches. They'll pay, but need clear pricing and contract language. Can we size a simple price anchor?

david (eng): Hard-burst means prewarmed capacity or reserved slots with preemption protection. Cost estimate: ~2x for short windows. Recommend autoscale policy with admission control + preempt buckets.

ravi (infra): Observability needs: per-tenant reserve_headroom, burst_ledger, burst_consumed, preempt_count. Also need a rollout gate for headroom metrics before GA.

hana (cust-succ): In pilots customers accept soft guarantees if SLAs and credits are clear. Hard-burst should be limited to a small set of pilots (legal + billing ok).

julia (sre): Runbook asks: explicit preempt order, graceful degrade path (fallback to smaller model), and eviction TTL. We can't have opaque evictions in customer contracts.

david (eng): Proposed autoscale config (prototype):
```
autoscale_policy:
  type: headroom
  headroom_tokens: 50000
  burst_window_s: 300
  hard_burst_enabled: true
  hard_burst_capacity: 4x
  preempt_order: ['best-effort','soft-reserve','hard-reserve']
```

mira (PM): Draft launch criteria — (1) telemetry validating <1% p99 breaches across pilot for 7 days, (2) billing + contract template, (3) SRE runbook + eviction SLIs, (4) 2 pilot customers committed.

david (eng): Rough timeline: 6w for infra + autoscale, 2w pilot, 1w docs/legal. Risks: kernel availability for fast prewarm and regional capacity fragmentation.

kevin (sales): I can bring in 3 pilot customers next sprint (one large, two mid-market). Will confirm contractual asks.

julia (sre): Add gating metric: fallback-success-rate > 99% during overload. Also require an automated alert if preempt_count spikes > 0.5% of requests.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create RFC and add to roadmap board before EOD Friday :bell:

mira (PM): Next steps — david to push PR with config + metrics, ravi to draft telemetry dashboard, kevin to confirm pilots, hana to prep onboarding notes. Sync on Thursday 10am. :eyes:
